fee_notes: The initial franchise fee is $35,000 per location, payable in a lump sum and non-refundable. For Area Development Agreements, a Development Fee of $17,500 per Store in the Development Schedule is required (estimated $175,000 to $262,500 for 10-15 Stores), which is credited in $17,500 increments toward the initial franchise fee for each Franchise Agreement signed. Opening inventory and supplies purchased from PCI are estimated at $10,000 to $15,000 and are separate from the franchise fee.
raw_excerpt: You must pay us an initial franchisee fee of $35,000 upon signing the Franchise Agreement. The initial franchise fee is payable in a lump sum and is non-refundable.
